title: Beyond Suspicious Steps: Ontological Trust in Long-Horizon Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.17718v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon agents increasingly operate across many steps, tools, and observa- tions. In this setting, the relevant oversight question is not only whether each action is locally valid, but whether the evolving trajectory still corresponds to the task the user authorized. Drift can accumulate quietly: an agent may call the right tool with plausible arguments at every step, while its prefix moves toward a broader role, an adjacent objective, or evidence the user never supplied. Existing monitors mostly check local compliance, deliver final-trace verdicts, or score generic risk; they do not directly estimate this prefix-level relation. We introduce ontological trust, a task-conditioned property of trajectory prefixes, and instantiate it as RGE, an online monitor that decomposes trust along Role, Goal, and Evidence. translated_title: 超越可疑步骤：长期任务智能体中的本体论信任
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17718v1 公告类型：新  摘要：长期任务智能体越来越多地在多个步骤、工具和观察中运作。在这种情境下，相关的监督问题不仅在于每个动作是否局部有效，还在于演化中的轨迹是否仍然对应于用户授权的任务。漂移可能悄然累积：一个智能体可能在每一步都调用正确的工具并给出合理的参数，而其前缀却朝着更广泛的角色、相邻的目标或用户从未提供的证据移动。现有监控器大多检查局部合规性、提供最终轨迹裁决或评分通用风险；它们并不直接估计这种前缀级关系。我们引入了本体论信任，这是一种任务条件化的轨迹前缀属性，并将其实例化为RGE，一种在线监控器，它将信任分解为角色、目标和证据三个维度。RGE仅使用LLM来推导结构化的任务和步骤表示；信任状态更新、投影和干预决策则...
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为“本体论信任”的新概念，用于监控长期任务智能体，通过分解角色、目标和证据三个维度，在线评估轨迹前缀与用户授权任务的一致性，以检测并干预潜在的漂移问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "ontological trust," a novel task-conditioned property of trajectory prefixes, instantiated as an RGE online monitor that decomposes trust along Role, Goal, and Evidence to detect and intervene in drift in long-horizon agents.
